arxiv-1402-3513.title: Ab initio design of charge-mismatched ferroelectric superlattices
arxiv-1402-3513.creator: Claudio Cazorla, Massimiliano Stengel
arxiv-1402-3513.description: Abstract We present a systematic approach to modeling the electrical and structural properties of charge-mismatched superlattices from first principles. Our strategy is based on bulk calculations of the parent compounds, which we perform as a function of in-plane strain and out-of-plane electric displacement field.

arxiv-2012-03894.title: OPE and quark-hadron duality for two-point functions of tetraquark currents in 𝟏 / 𝑵 𝒄 1/N_{c} expansion
arxiv-2012-03894.creator: Wolfgang Lucha a , Dmitri Melikhov b,c,d , Hagop Sazdjian e
arxiv-2012-03894.description: Abstract We discuss the Operator Product Expansion (OPE) and quark-hadron duality for two-point Green functions of tetraquark currents. We emphasize that the factorizable part of the OPE series for such Green functions, including nonperturbative contributions described by QCD condensates, is saturated by the full system of ordinary hadrons and therefore cannot have any relationship to the possible tetraquark bound states.

arxiv-2101-09488.title: Chiral Condensate in Two Dimensional Models
arxiv-2101-09488.creator: V.G. Ksenzov
arxiv-2101-09488.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V.G. Ksenzov. We investigate two different models. In one of them massive fermions interact with a massive scalar field and in the other the fermion field is in an electrical field (QED2). The chiral condensates are calculated in one-loop approximation. We found that the chiral condensate in the case of the Yukawa interaction the fermions and scalar field does not vanish if the mass of the fermion field tends to zero. The chiral condensate disappears in QED2, if the fermion mass is zero.

arxiv-2110-03844.title: Ballistic magnetotransport in graphene
arxiv-2110-03844.creator: Ke Wang, T. A. Sedrakyan
arxiv-2110-03844.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ke Wang, T. A. Sedrakyan. We report that a perpendicular magnetic field introduces an anomalous interaction correction, δ ​ σ \delta\sigma , to the static conductivity of doped graphene in the ballistic regime. The correction implies that the magnetoresistance, δ ​ ρ x ​ x \delta\rho_{xx} scales inversely with temperature δ ​ ρ x ​ x ​ ( T ) ∝ 1 / T \delta\rho_{xx}(T)\propto 1/T in a parametrically large interval.

arxiv-2207-04600.title: Optimal Clustering by Lloyd’s Algorithm for Low-Rank Mixture Model
arxiv-2207-04600.creator: Zhongyuan Lyu, Dong Xia
arxiv-2207-04600.description: Abstract This paper investigates the computational and statistical limit in clustering matrix-valued observations. We propose a low-rank mixture model (LrMM), adapted from the classical Gaussian mixture model (GMM) to treat matrix-valued observations, which assumes low-rankness for population center matrices. A computationally efficient clustering method is designed by integrating Lloyd’s algorithm and low-rank approximation.

arxiv-2209-13242.title: Timespot1: A 28 nm 28\text{\,}\mathrm{nm} CMOS Pixel Read-Out ASIC for 4D Tracking at High Rates
arxiv-2209-13242.creator: Alberto Stabile
arxiv-2209-13242.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alberto Stabile. We present the first characterization results of Timespot1, an ASIC designed in CMOS 28 nm 28\text{\,}\mathrm{nm} technology, featuring a 32 × 32 32\text{\times}32 pixel matrix with a pitch of 55 µ ​ m 55\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m} . Timespot1 is the first small-size prototype, conceived to readout fine-pitch pixels with single-hit time resolution below 50 ps rms $50\text{\,}\mathrm{ps}$_{\text{rms}} and input rates of several hundreds of kilohertz per pixel.

arxiv-2305-01428.title: Edge Universality of Random Regular Graphs of Growing Degrees
arxiv-2305-01428.creator: Horng-Tzer Yau
arxiv-2305-01428.description: Abstract We consider the statistics of extreme eigenvalues of random d d -regular graphs, with N 𝔠 ⩽ d ⩽ N 1 / 3 − 𝔠 N^{\mathfrak{c}}\leqslant d\leqslant N^{1/3-{\mathfrak{c}}} for arbitrarily small 𝔠 > 0 {\mathfrak{c}}>0 . We prove that in this regime, the fluctuations of extreme eigenvalues are given by the Tracy-Widom distribution.

arxiv-2310-01277.description: Abstract We present the characterization and definitive flux calibration of the Far-Infrared Field Integral Line Spectrometer ( FIFI-LS ) instrument on-board SOFIA . The work is based on measurements made in the laboratory with an internal calibrator and on observations of planets, moons, and asteroids as absolute flux calibrators made during the entire lifetime of the instrument.

arxiv-2404-09075.creator: Mingjie Li, S. A. R. Horsley
arxiv-2404-09075.description: Abstract We find a new set of exact solutions to Maxwell’s equations in space–time varying materials, where the refractive index is constant, while the impedance exhibits effective motion, i.e. it is a function of x − v ​ t x-vt .

arxiv-2405-01342.title: Data-Driven Strategies for Detecting and Sampling Misrepresented Subgroups
arxiv-2405-01342.creator: G. Lancia, F. Mecatti, E. Riccomagno
arxiv-2405-01342.description: Abstract Economic policy research often investigates population well-being, with particular attention to the links between unequal living conditions, low education, and social exclusion. Sample surveys such as EU-SILC are widely used for this purpose and inform public policy, yet their sampling designs may fail to adequately represent rare, hard-to-sample, or under-covered subgroups.

arxiv-2510-05770.title: Radiative-Corrected Higgs Inflation in Light of the Latest ACT Observations
arxiv-2510-05770.creator: Jureeporn Yuennan, Farruh Atamurotov, Phongpichit Channuie
arxiv-2510-05770.description: Abstract Recent measurements from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT), particularly when combined with DESI baryon acoustic oscillation data, have reported a scalar spectral index n s n_{s} slightly higher than that inferred by Planck 2018, suggesting a mild tension with the predictions of standard inflationary attractor models.

pmc-12364367.title: Flushing peripheral intravenous catheters: A scoping review
pmc-12364367.creator: Jiaxin Deng, Orlaith Hernon, Caitríona Duggan, Leo R. Quinlan, Zina Alfahl, Peter J. Carr, Erik Su, Erik Su, Erik Su
pmc-12364367.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPeripheral intravascular catheters (PIVCs) are indispensable vascular access devices in healthcare, facilitating the administration of intravenous therapies. Despite their vital role, PIVCs are frequently associated with complications such as occlusion, infection, and thrombosis, which contribute to catheter failure. Flushing catheters is one of the most common practices during PIVC maintenance, as it cleans the internal catheter lumen, ensuring patency and reducing the risk of complications.

pmc-12539121.title: Expression of multidrug efflux pump gene acrAB in Escherichia coli: a systematic review and meta analysis
pmc-12539121.creator: Saleh Salem Bahaj, Mohammed Saleh Al-Dhubaibi, Aref Noman, Sarosh Sher Ali, Haaris Mehmood, Waleed Yahya Alkassar, Ahmed Mohammed Al-Dhubaibi, Ghada Farouk Mohammed, Ahmed Ibrahim Abd Elneam
pmc-12539121.description: BackgroundMultidrug-resistant (MDR) Escherichia coli (E.coli) is a growing public health concern, largely driven by the overexpression of efflux pumps such as AcrAB-tolC. These efflux systems contribute to resistance against multiple antibiotic classes, including fluoroquinolones, β-lactams, and aminoglycosides. Despite the well-documented role of efflux pumps in resistance, inconsistencies in reported expression levels and regulatory mechanisms complicate the development of targeted therapies.

pmc-12570261.title: From Plant Material to Environmentally Friendly Plant Growth Stimulators: Betaine-Based Ionic Liquids
pmc-12570261.creator: Adriana Olejniczak, Michał Niemczak, Daniela Gwiazdowska, Krzysztof Juś, Andrea Mezzetta, Lorenzo Guazzelli, Damian Krystian Kaczmarek
pmc-12570261.description: Following global trends, the main issue is to ensure that humanity can progress without harming the environment. This article outlines the synthesis of novel ionic liquids composed of an alkylbetaine cation, whose structure is based on glycine-betaine (a byproduct of sugar beet production) and an anion based on indole-3-butyric acid (a natural auxin found in plants).

pmc-12736764.creator: Teodora Lukavski, Josip Bota, Ivan Budimir, Katarina Itrić Ivanda, Rahela Kulčar, Marina Vukoje Bezjak, Ian Wyman
pmc-12736764.description: Polymer waste poses significant environmental challenges and polymers’ replacement with biodegradable biopolymers is therefore crucial. Protective coatings are recognized as a problem in the graphics industry, since they are based on synthetic polymers that are not biodegradable. To be effective, coatings in this industry must meet several key criteria, including stability, functionality, recyclability, and a suitable shelf life.

pmc-12747953.creator: Shunyi Huang, Cenwen Liu, Xueying Zeng, Zihan Huang, Feng Lin, Yongyuan Chen, Guanxiang Zhuo, Yunyun Mei, Qing Guan
pmc-12747953.description: Intrathyroidal thymic carcinoma (ITTC) is a rare malignant tumor that presents significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. pmc-13348863.description: BackgroundPolynucleotide (PN) injections are increasingly used for facial rejuvenation, but severe infectious complications remain poorly characterized.Case ReportWe report an otherwise healthy 57‐year‐old woman who developed progressive bilateral cheek inflammation after facial PN injections.
